about: Design directions: complete starting systems (tokens, type, shape, layout, motion, copy) with the atlas studies that suit each. Study ids resolve in catalog.json and studies.md.

directions.name: Quiet product
directions.oneLine: Neutral, precise software UI where the product itself is the hero.

type.scale: 14/15 body, 13 UI labels, 20 / 28 / 44 / 64 headings, tight -0.02em on headings
type.notes: One family in two or three weights. Mono for numbers, ids, keyboard hints and code only.

shape.border: 1px hairlines carry structure; shadows only on floating layers

layout: Show the real product UI big in the first screen, inside a framed app window, working on believable data.
Feature sections pair one sentence with one real UI fragment each; vary the fragment, never repeat an icon grid.
Left-aligned text on a 12-column grid; centre only the closing call to action.
directions.motion: Micro only: tab indicators that slide, 150-200ms ease-out on hover and press, number tickers. Content stays still while scrolling.
directions.copy: Plain verbs and specifics: what it does, for whom, one measurable fact. Buttons say verb + object (Start a trial, Invite your team).
keep: Swap the accent for the brand colour but keep one accent only.
Every number on the page is real or clearly a product mock.

directions.name: Dark technical
directions.oneLine: Dark, exact and a little cinematic, for infrastructure, AI and developer tools.

type.scale: 15 body, 12 mono labels in caps with 0.08em tracking, 56-88 hero
type.notes: Mono labels and code blocks give it texture; headings stay sans and tight.

shape.border: 1px lines at ~10% white; glow only on the one accent element
shape.density: Generous section spacing, dense inside panels

layout: Hero: one-line claim, a terminal or code sample that really runs, and one signature visual behind or beside it.
Diagrams of how data flows (beams, circuit lines) explain the product better than icon cards.
Changelog-style proof: versions, latency numbers, regions, commands.
directions.motion: One ambient visual in the hero, paused offscreen; everything else static or 150ms. Respect reduced motion.
directions.copy: Terse and technical. Show the command, the number, the guarantee. No hype words.
keep: Use dist/colour-themes.html to pick semantic dark colours with measured contrast.
Pick exactly one signature visual; the rest of the page is type, code and lines.

directions.name: Editorial catalogue
directions.oneLine: Warm paper, a serif display face and mono catalogue labels, like a museum catalogue.

type.scale: 15 body, 11 mono labels, 44 section heads, 72-92 hero; serif at regular weight, italic for one emphasised word
type.notes: Serif only for display. Numbered items (No 001) in mono with the accent colour.

shape.border: 1px warm lines, dashed dividers inside cards
shape.density: Airy; cards with an inner mat around images

layout: Treat each item as a numbered plate: mounted image, number, title, one line, metadata row.
Large serif section heads left-aligned with a short sans line under them.
Filters as pill rows above the grid; detail opens as a large stage with a spec sheet beside it.
directions.motion: Cards lift 2px and images zoom 1.03 on hover; dialogs rise in once. Nothing animates on scroll.
directions.copy: Curatorial and specific: say what each thing is and why it was chosen, in one line.
keep: The atlas home page itself is the reference build of this direction.

directions.name: Newsprint
directions.oneLine: Columns, rules and strong serif headlines for reading-first sites.

type.scale: 18-19 body at 1.6 line height and 65ch measure; 40-110 headlines in bold serif; small caps for kickers
type.notes: Serif body is fine here because reading is the job. Sans only for UI chrome.

shape.border: Hairline and double rules between sections, column rules between columns
shape.density: Dense front page, spacious article page

layout: Front page as a multi-column grid with a lead story, secondary stories and a briefs column.
Article page: one column, generous margins, pull quotes and figure captions.
Section filters as a text row under the masthead.
directions.motion: Almost none: underline draws on links, dialogs fade. Reading wins.
directions.copy: Headlines that state the news; standfirsts that add the second fact. Bylines and dates are real.
keep: Rules and columns do the decorating, so imagery can be sparse and black-and-white or halftone.

directions.name: Swiss grid
directions.oneLine: Strict grid, big grotesk type, one red, lots of white.

type.scale: Huge contrast: 15 body, 120+ display in 600 weight, -0.04em tracking; numbers set large
type.notes: One grotesk family. Hierarchy from size and position, never from colour.

shape.density: Strict 12-column grid with visible alignment; asymmetric white space

layout: Project index as a table: number, name, year, discipline, with hover image preview.
Asymmetric compositions: text hangs from the grid lines, images bleed to one column edge.
Toggle between list and grid views of work.
directions.motion: Instant or 120ms. A single geometric interaction is enough.
directions.copy: Short labels, numbers and facts. Let the grid speak.
keep: Red marks one thing per screen: the active item, the date, the main action.

directions.name: Operational enterprise
directions.oneLine: Dense, calm and keyboard-friendly UI for people who work in it all day.

type.scale: 14 body, 12 table and label text, 20 / 28 page titles; tabular numbers everywhere
type.notes: Plex throughout. Tabular figures for any column of numbers.

shape.border: Hairlines and zebra-free tables; status shown with colour plus icon plus word
shape.density: Compact: 32px rows, 8px grid, persistent side navigation

layout: Shell: side navigation, breadcrumb header, page title with primary action at the right.
Tables with sticky headers, filters, bulk actions and a detail side panel.
Status, owner and next step visible on every record.
directions.motion: Functional only: panel slides, row highlight, progress. Nothing decorative.
directions.copy: Labels say exactly what the field holds. Errors say what happened and what to do next.
keep: Design the empty, loading and error states with the same care as the full table.

directions.name: Casework and service
directions.oneLine: Clear, trustworthy flows for forms, cases and public or support services.

type.notes: Readable before stylish. Large tap targets and visible labels.

shape.border: 2px borders on inputs, thick focus rings in a high-contrast colour
shape.density: One question or one task per screen

layout: Step-by-step flows with a progress indicator and a check-your-answers page before submit.
Case pages: status timeline, what happens next, who to contact.
Content pages use a 65ch column with clear headings and summary boxes.
directions.motion: Practically none. Confirmation states and focus moves must be obvious.
directions.copy: Plain English at reading age 9-12. Tell people what they need before they start and how long it takes.
keep: Every error message names the field and how to fix it, next to the field.

directions.name: Warm consumer
directions.oneLine: Rounded, friendly and tactile for apps people use on their phones.

type.scale: 16 body, 600 weight UI, 32 / 48 / 64 headings with slight negative tracking
type.notes: Characterful display face, plain body face.

shape.border: Soft fills over borders; one soft shadow level

layout: Show the app in a phone frame on the first screen, mid-task, with real-looking content.
Sections pair a short benefit with one screen of the app or one illustration.
Bottom sheets and big toggles on mobile; one main action per screen.
directions.motion: Springy and short: switches, rings filling, sheets snapping. 200-350ms springs.
directions.copy: Second person, warm and specific. Name the outcome the person gets this week.
keep: Change the accent to the brand colour, keeping the warm off-white ground.

directions.name: Organic botanical
directions.oneLine: Earthy colour, serif warmth and natural imagery for lifestyle and food brands.

type.scale: 16-17 body, 40-96 display in Fraunces with soft optical size
type.notes: Fraunces at low weight with italic accents; Karla keeps body text calm.

shape.radius: Organic: 24px, arched image frames for one feature
shape.border: Thin warm lines; no hard shadows

layout: Real photographs lead: produce, rooms, hands at work. Square or arched frames.
Menu, products or treatments as a calm list with prices, not as cards with icons.
Visit block early: hours, street and booking in one place.
directions.motion: Image crossfades and gentle hover zoom only.
directions.copy: Sensory and concrete: name the ingredient, the place, the hour.
keep: Photography carries this style. Use real or clearly labelled stand-in photographs.

directions.name: Bold maximal
directions.oneLine: Loud colour, huge type and collage for events, music and campaigns.

type.scale: 16 body; display 120-240 uppercase, condensed, tight leading
type.notes: Condensed display at poster sizes. Mix in one script or serif word only if the brand has one.

shape.radius: Mixed on purpose: pills, circles and hard rectangles
shape.density: Layered and packed, but one clear action per screen

layout: Poster-like hero: date, place and line-up set as huge type, layered with cut-out imagery.
Line-up or schedule as giant typographic lists.
Ticket builder or tier picker as the main interaction.
directions.motion: Kinetic headlines and marquee once per page; parallax limited to poster layers.
directions.copy: Punchy and factual: what, when, where, who, how much. Energy comes from type, not adjectives.
keep: Pick the palette from the brand or the poster art; keep body text dark on light for reading.

directions.name: Neo brutal
directions.oneLine: Flat colour blocks, thick outlines and hard shadows for opinionated indie products.

type.notes: One quirky grotesk. Mono for prices and tags.

shape.border: 3px black borders on everything interactive; 4px offset hard shadows

layout: Cards and buttons with hard shadows that press down on click.
Pricing as three bold blocks in different flat colours, with the honest limits listed.
Sticker-like badges for status and highlights.
directions.motion: Press and lift on buttons (translate 2-4px with the shadow). Nothing floaty.
directions.copy: Blunt and funny where honest. Say the limits out loud.
keep: Use two or three flat block colours beside the accent, each with black text.

directions.name: Luxury deco
directions.oneLine: Deep colour, fine gold lines and high-contrast serifs for hospitality and luxury.

type.scale: 16 body in Jost with wide tracked caps labels (0.2em), 48-110 display in Cormorant 500
type.notes: High-contrast serif display; geometric sans for small caps labels.

shape.radius: 0, or arched tops for one frame
shape.border: Fine 1px gold rules, stepped deco corners, symmetrical frames

layout: Symmetrical, centred compositions with framed photography.
Reservation or enquiry block always one step away.
Menus, rooms or collections as elegant lists with fine rules.
directions.motion: Slow fades (400-600ms) and line draws; nothing bouncy.
directions.copy: Understated and exact. Fewer words, specific nouns, no superlatives.
keep: Gold is for lines and small marks; large areas stay deep colour or photograph.

directions.name: Retro playful
directions.oneLine: Pixel art, old desktops and 8-bit feedback for games and nostalgic microsites.

type.scale: 16 body; pixel font only for short headings and labels at 12-24px
type.notes: Pixel fonts are hard to read; keep body text in a normal sans.

shape.border: Pixel borders (box-shadow steps) or bevelled windows

layout: UI as a game screen or old desktop: windows, panels, status bars.
Pixel loaders and pixel reveals for transitions.
Scores, levels and progress as the main visual language.
directions.motion: Stepped (steps() easing), short, with sound off by default.
directions.copy: Game-like and short: verbs, scores, levels.
keep: Keep a non-pixel font for anything longer than a phrase.

directions.name: Immersive showcase
directions.oneLine: One 3D or shader centrepiece and scroll-told chapters, for launches with budget.

type.scale: 16 body, 72-160 display, chapter numbers in mono
type.notes: Type stays simple so the scene carries the drama.

shape.border: Minimal; the scene is the frame

layout: Hero is the object or scene, big and whole, with one line of copy and one action.
Chapters advance with scroll, each showing a different view or part.
Specs and buying or contact details in a calm, static final section.
directions.motion: Scroll-linked inside the story section only; provide a static fallback and pause controls.
directions.copy: Short lines per chapter, each naming one feature and one number.
keep: Budget: one WebGL context in view at a time, disposed offscreen, with a still image fallback.

directions.name: Data report
directions.oneLine: Editorial reporting that leads with the finding and supports it with clear charts.

type.scale: 17 body, 40-64 serif headlines that state the finding; big numbers 64-120 in sans with tabular figures
type.notes: Serif for findings, sans for data and labels.

shape.density: Reading column plus wide chart breakouts

layout: Each section opens with the finding as a sentence, then the chart, then the caveat.
Key numbers in a row with what changed and over what period.
Charts direct-labelled, one highlighted series, the rest grey.
directions.motion: Charts draw once when shown; numbers do not tick on every scroll.
directions.copy: Lead with the number and what it means. Give the period, the sample and the source.
keep: One highlight colour per chart; label series directly instead of a legend.
